_comment: Every exception needs a justification and an expiry date. The gate ignores an expired entry, so nothing is suppressed forever. Add an entry only after reasoning about reachability, never to make a run go green.

exceptions.justification: The entrypoint starts as root only to chown the data volumes and drop to PUID:PGID with gosu, which Unraid needs (99:100). The shipped compose file and Unraid template now run it with all capabilities dropped except CHOWN, SETUID, SETGID and FOWNER, no-new-privileges and a read-only root, and the app process runs unprivileged with no capabilities (NET-4 on every run).

Go standard library inside the gosu helper. gosu only calls setuid/setgid and execs the app; it opens no sockets and parses no network input, so the vulnerable code is not reachable. Re-check when a gosu release built with a newer Go is available.
False positive. The rule flags MCP tool registration; none of the tools accept a URL or path argument. Enforced by test MCP-13 (no tool exposes shell, file-system or URL access).
False positive. This is a 2-second readiness probe of cloudflared's metrics port on the container's own loopback address.
Code-quality hint, not a security issue.
